levels.surface: سالم بن عبد الله بن عمر

notes: «ح» separates two routes. The first, as written, ends at «سالم» (the text names no Ibn Umar in it); the second writes its names in full down to «ابن عمر». Whether the second route's tail belongs to the first too is for ruling, so the first group is not extended.
«- هو ابن سعيد -» and «- وهو الزهري -» are editor's glosses between dashes and are left out; «عثمان» and «محمد» are read as written.
The saying «رأيت رسول الله» is Ibn Umar's, so he is the last link of the second route.
